formulas.matched_gold_zero: error = 0 when pred=0; else fixed penalty=1.0
formulas.missing_or_extra: error = 1.0 (category in union but only one side)
formulas.query_error: mean(per_category_error over union of gold and predicted categories)

zero_denominator_note: When gold=0 and pred!=0, error is a fixed penalty (1.0), not relative error / epsilon.
